disclaimer: Simplified estimate for Chilean Second Category Tax on salaries. Chile officially expresses brackets in UTA/UTM units; this file uses approximate CLP-annualized bands. Social security (AFP), health (Fonasa/Isapre), and unemployment insurance are not included.

regimes.label: Second Category Tax (2024, Approx.)
regimes.notes: Chile defines brackets in tax units (UTA) that change monthly. These CLP figures are an approximation for a representative period and should be verified against current UTA values.
